# Warehouse Simulation Toolkit assets

The `workcell` and `workcell_bin` model assets in this directory were obtained
from the Warehouse Simulation Toolkit project.

- Upstream repository:
  https://github.com/wh200720041/warehouse_simulation_toolkit
- Upstream revision:
  `18df8ce6dde61711e0705f3bd872465a01bd01a2`
- Upstream license:
  BSD 3-Clause License
- Original license:
  Preserved in the accompanying `LICENSE` file

These third-party assets were originally designed for ROS 1 and Gazebo Classic.
They have been adapted for ROS 2 Jazzy and Gazebo Sim 8 in this project.

These assets remain covered by their upstream BSD 3-Clause License and are not
